addon_info.name: Cr8 Render
addon_info.author: Cr8-xyz <thamsanqa.dev@gmail.com>
addon_info.description: Image rendering and cloud output for AI agents

ai_integration.agent_description:
This addon renders finished images from the scene and uploads them to the user's cloud storage library.

The user chooses a camera, an output resolution and a render engine; sampling, denoising and GPU device selection are handled internally at production-quality defaults, so there is no need to reason about sample counts. EEVEE is fast and suits look development and quick previews; Cycles is path-traced and suits final, photoreal output at the cost of render time.

Rendering blocks Blender's main thread — the viewport freezes and no other command runs until it finishes. A 4K Cycles render can take several minutes. Do not issue a render as a side effect of an unrelated request, and do not issue a second render while one is in progress.

The upload target is minted by the engine and passed in as the `multipart` parameter. Without it the render has nowhere to go and will fail.

tools.name: render_image
tools.description: Render the current frame from a camera and save it to the user's render library
tools.usage: Use when the user asks for a render, an image, a still, or a final shot. Confirm which camera if the scene has more than one and the user did not say.

parameters.name: camera
parameters.description: Name of the camera object to render from. Omit to use the scene's active camera.

parameters.name: engine
parameters.description: Render engine. EEVEE is fast; CYCLES is path-traced and slower but photoreal.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Output resolution tier, applied to the long edge: hd=1920, 2k=2560, 4k=3840.

parameters.name: aspect
parameters.description: Aspect ratio of the output image.

parameters.name: multipart
parameters.description: Pre-signed multipart upload descriptor minted by the engine ({upload_id, key, part_size, part_urls}). Passed through verbatim; never construct this.

parameters.name: thumb_url
parameters.description: Pre-signed PUT URL for the library thumbnail, minted by the engine.

examples: give me a final render with cycles
render a square image for instagram

context_hints: Rendering blocks Blender's main thread — the viewport freezes until it completes
Cycles at 4K can take several minutes; EEVEE is the right default for iteration
Sampling and denoising are handled internally — the user only picks camera, resolution and engine
Renders are saved to the user's cloud library under the currently open project
A project that has never been saved to the cloud has nowhere to file renders and must be saved first
